question: Should Crabline preserve its Node 22 runtime contract and reject this typings major, or intentionally raise the project’s runtime and declaration floor to Node 26?
rationale: Choosing the declaration major defines which Node APIs contributors may safely use and therefore cannot be separated from the project’s supported runtime policy.

options.title: Keep Node 22 typings
options.body: Close or ignore this major update and accept only compatible 22.x declaration updates while Node 22 remains supported.

options.title: Raise the runtime floor
options.body: Replace this PR with a coordinated Node 26 migration covering engines, CI, documentation, verification, and upgrade expectations.

recommendation.title: Keep Node 22 typings
recommendation.body: Close or ignore this major update and accept only compatible 22.x declaration updates while Node 22 remains supported.

likelyOwner.reason: The runtime support floor is repository-wide policy, and this account appears in the project’s foundational runtime history.
